name: logbook
description: Run the agentic engineering loop against a logbook board: file build-ready logs, explore blast radius, spec UX, plan collision-aware batches, and drive build → review → fix → merge with an orchestrator and subagents.

baseBranch.title: Base branch
baseBranch.description: Branch that feature branches cut from and pull requests target.

testCommand.title: Test command
testCommand.description: Command that runs the test suite for a scoped change. Leave blank to have the skills detect it from the repo.

webhookWired.title: GitHub merge webhook is configured
webhookWired.description: When true, a merged pull request closes its log automatically and the loop leaves items in_progress. When false, the loop marks items done itself — otherwise finished work is never closed.
